More info for the peoples who don't go to the Steam discussion.

 

Did some research on a pair of Cosmitron games, one my own and one from a pair of games that led to a successful unlock, and I turned up some interesting statistics. That said, we don't have many successful Cosmitron games to look through, so this information, while useful, is not from a large sample size.

 

-In both games, Omni-X died while at least one of each of his components were in the trash.

-In both games, one of each of all of Cosmitron's cards were in his trash.

-In one game, Self Sabotage destroyed one Omni-X component, while in the other, it destroyed 3 Cosmitron components.

-In both games, Reset was NOT played.

 

From this, and from the general concensus regarding this game, we can list some likely requirements for the Cosmitron game, in order from most likely to least likely:

-Omnitron-X must be the only incapacitated hero. (All unlockers have confirmed this to be a part of their game.)

-Self Sabotage must be played at least once. (All unlockers have confirmed this to be a part of their game.)

-At least one of each of Omnitron-X's Component cards (Electro-Deployment Unit, Gaussian Coil Blaster, Innervation Ray, Focused Plasma Cannon) must be in his trash before he dies.

-At least one of each of Omnitron-II's Ongoings* (Adaptive Plating Subroutine, Disintegration Beam, Interpolation Beam, Electro-Magnetic Railgun) must be in the villain trash at the end of the game.

-At least one of each of Omnitron-II's Devices* (S-83 Assault Drone, S-84 Automaton Drone, S-85 Repair Drone, Electro-Pulse Explosive) must be in the villain trash at the end of the game.

-At least one of each of Omnitron-II's One-Shots (Terraforming, Technological Singularity, Sedative Flechettes) must be in the villain trash at the end of the game.**

-Omnitron-X must not play Reset.***

 

*The reason I said Ongoings instead of Components is because of a failed Cosmitron game log we have where every single requirement listed above was met EXCEPT for having Adaptive Plating Subroutine in the trash. Mind you, he also didn't have Electro-Pulse Explosive in there, either, but I'm personally not yet sold on needing all the devices or drones in there just yet. Still, to cover my bases, I included it in the list as a possibility.

**Personally I just think it unlikely that villain one-shots are a thing that are needed for this unlock. Still, it happened, so it's in the list.
